title: Unable to play midrolls
body:
### [REQUIRED] Issue description
When _timeOffset_ atribute in VMAP has non zero milliseconds and ads server does not return ad, next ads will not be played any more.

### [REQUIRED] Reproduction steps
Use VMAP below and seek between two midrolls.

### [REQUIRED] Link to test content
[https://devs.origin.cdn.cra.cz/ima/zenexoupdate.xml](https://devs.origin.cdn.cra.cz/ima/zenexoupdate.xml)
